verdict.rationale: Conta Simples has a documented public REST API with an OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials quickstart, scoped credentials, and a per-endpoint API reference with an interactive playground. The API covers cards, VCN issuance and top-up, bills, balances, statements and reconciliation, categories, cost centers, suppliers, users, and attachments. Agent-friendly touches include Markdown versions of every page and a live llms.txt (confirmed by probe). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of real API use, and explicit API coverage of Pix/boleto/batch payment operations.
